title: Neon Highway
blurb: Race a synthwave road into the sunset through spinning wheels, sliding traffic and spike strips.

levels.name: Ignition
levels.intro: Hit the seven orange pegs on the spinning hubcap. Land on the plate to win your ball back.

levels.name: Vanishing Point
levels.intro: Break eighty pegs. Light streaks race along the road toward you.

levels.name: Speed Bumps
levels.intro: New: bumpers never break and fling your ball. Reach twenty thousand points.

levels.name: Green Light
levels.intro: New: the timed plate takes turns catching and bouncing. Hit the ten green pegs.

levels.name: Chevron Run
levels.intro: New: oily sludge slows your ball right down. Make a chain of eighteen in one shot.

levels.name: Palm Boulevard
levels.intro: New: thieves steal a saved power, or points. Hit the eight orange pegs on the sunset.

levels.name: Spike Strip
levels.intro: New: red spikes pop your ball. Collect the six gems and steer clear of the spikes.

levels.name: Cassette Deck
levels.intro: Two reels turn together. Make a chain of twenty six pegs in one shot.

levels.name: Retro Sun
levels.intro: New: bricks take a few hits, and their colour shows how many. Break every brick in the sun.

levels.name: Toll Booth
levels.intro: New: hit a key to open the gate of its colour. Hit all eight orange pegs, three are in the booths.

levels.name: Rush Hour
levels.intro: New: shrinkers make your ball tiny for a shot. Break fifty pegs in the traffic.

levels.name: Night Rider
levels.intro: New: glass shatters at a touch and lets your ball through. Grab the five gems on the car.

levels.name: Equalizer
levels.intro: The bars pump to the beat. Reach fifteen thousand points.

levels.name: Cloverleaf
levels.intro: New: portals send your ball to the matching portal. Hit the ten orange pegs on the loops.

levels.name: Tachometer
levels.intro: Clear every peg on the dial. The needle sweeps the whole gauge.

levels.name: Neon Skyline
levels.intro: Light all eight lanterns over the city. Lit lanterns keep glowing.

levels.name: Loop the Loop
levels.intro: Get inside the loop and make a chain of twenty in one shot.

levels.name: Night Bridge
levels.intro: Break every brick in the bridge. The armour on the towers needs a blast or fire.

levels.name: Synthwave
levels.intro: Hit the nine orange pegs riding the three rolling waves.

levels.name: Finish Line
levels.intro: The flag ripples in the wind. Hit the ten orange squares to take the chequered flag.
